run_PostProcessFlickr: run PostProcessFlickr to convert model outputs into sorted bounding boxes for Flickr30k entities evaluation
create_PostProcessFlickr_call: create a PostProcessFlickr instance and call it with logits, boxes, target sizes, positive map, and phrases per sample
test_PostProcessFlickr: test PostProcessFlickr by passing model predictions and phrase masks to get sorted bounding box coordinates
review_PostProcessFlickr_call: review the PostProcessFlickr __call__ method that converts cxcywh boxes to xyxy format and scales to absolute coordinates
summarize_PostProcessFlickr: summarize PostProcessFlickr which computes softmax probabilities and matches phrases to bounding boxes using positive token masks
